description:
HushGram v0.0.2 is the first release. It targets Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 (com.instagram.android) with 21 patches. Hide ads, Sanitize sharing links, Disable analytics and Remove build expired popup do the core work, and the Reels, Stories, Playback and Downloads patches each get their own switch in HushGram's settings.

Read Before you sign in in the README first. Instagram checks the app when you sign in, and a re-signed build can't pass those checks, so use an account you've had a while and don't clear the app's data afterward.

Validation: 540 runtime tests passed locally. All 213 patch tests passed too. All 21 patches applied to Instagram 449.0.0.52.84 without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed. The same patch code was patched and installed through Morphe Manager on an Android 16 phone.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 449.0.0.52.84, version code 385511871. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not an Instagram APK. Uninstall the Play Store Instagram first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
